comments.text:
🌎 Want to see how life works in another remote corner of the world? Watch our next journey here:
👉 *Living in Saba | How Life Works on an Island with Almost No Flat Land* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OMnM1kYyvNk
👉 *Living in Tuvalu | How Life Works in a Country That Could Disappear* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XLfBG7wXwQ4
👉 *Living in Palmerston | How Life Works on an Island with Only 30 People* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wtCSJtL3bg4
If this were your family’s land, would you rather protect it for future generations—or have the freedom to sell it when your family needs money or opportunity? I’m really curious where you’d draw the line.
